title: A Conversation with Fire Chief Charles DeSmith
subtitle: A video podcast?!? Yes, yes it is.
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a health-themed substack…that is also a sort-of-media brand! Today, my first video interview podcast thing…I talked to Chuck DeSmith, a King County, Washington fire chief! I really enjoyed this remarkable conversation, and I hope you do as well.

Share The Frontier Psychiatrists

If you enjoyed this, and want more, let me know! I can try to do more. Comments are open, and please follow the YouTube channel, too!
